description: G1-13 S2R active-generation maintenance, restart phase (INV-HOST-DELIVERY-MAINTENANCE-001), through the use case `HostDelivery.maintain` on the LABELLED S2R fixtures (each store a fresh schema on a labelled disposable PostgreSQL, migrated by the side's PostgresStore): `restart --check` writes nothing, `restart` replaces the incumbent (`started`) and a replay is cached; an unsupported phase, a wrong evidence reference, a tampered document and a wrong reason are refused by name; an open generation holds its target. M7 has no maintenance: the reference is the approved rebaseline wheel (main-s2r-b9d8f15) and its golden lives under goldens/rebaseline/ (G1-13C-COMPARE-DECISION rule 5)
